item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 09 November 2026(Monday)

Light to moderate rains are expected over Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Miguel, San Ildefonso, San Rafael, San Jose del Monte, Angat), Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gapan, Penaranda, Bongabon, Rizal, General Mamerto Natividad, Llanera, Cabanatuan, Talavera, Palayan, Santo Domingo, Aliaga, Santa Rosa, Laur, Gabaldon), Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, Tanay, San Mateo), Zambales(Botolan, Cabangan, San Marcelino, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Laguna(Santa Maria).

Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(General Nakar) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:00 AM, 09 November 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad and Norzagaray) and Nueva Ecija (General Tinio and Gabaldon) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Quezon (General Nakar) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
